sources.title: GPT-5.6 Terra API model
sources.evidence: Exact undated model ID and default snapshot; 1,050,000 context, 922,000 input and 128,000 output tokens. Text/image input, text output, reasoning efforts none through max with medium default, function calling, Responses/Chat Completions/Batch and prompt caching are documented. No immutable dated snapshot is listed. Reopened for the October 27 parameter pass from the exact official Markdown fetched HTTP 200 at 16:22 UTC. It reports no nominal total or active count; its comparison to the earlier mini tier is product positioning, not a named counted base-model relationship.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 launch, July 9, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 via the live OpenAI page after the direct cache request returned HTTP 403. Names Sol, Terra and Luna as tiers in the GPT-5.6 generation and makes Terra available in Work, Codex and the API starting July 9. Calls Terra a smaller model and distinguishes durable capability tiers, but gives no nominal total/active count or counted base-model lineage. Benchmark and price tables do not measure parameters.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: July 9 entry explicitly releases gpt-5.6-terra alongside Sol and Luna. July 30 reduces Terra pricing; August 5 expands Fast mode to long-context requests. The gpt-5.6 alias routes to Sol, not Terra.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 System Card
sources.evidence: Reopened the original PDF fetched HTTP 200 October 27 at 15:42 UTC, including section 2 training, section 7.3.2 chain-of-thought controllability and section 9.4.3.1 separately trained activation classifiers for Sol and Terra. The full-text parameter search yields training hyperparameters and an unrelated dollar threshold, not model size. Section 9.4.9 describes protecting model weights. No nominal Terra total or active parameter count is reported; classifiers and safety-system components do not establish those counts.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Terra
sources.evidence: Reopened the later original PDF fetched HTTP 200 October 27 at 15:42 UTC. Table 22 has an exact gpt-5.6-terra column for safety scores; subsequent exact Terra health/biology comparisons likewise report evaluation results. Neither the tables nor the full-text parameter search supplies nominal total or activated parameters for GPT-5.6 Terra. Calling 5.6 Terra a predecessor does not establish a shared counted base.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 inference efficiency, July 29, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 via the live OpenAI page after the direct cache request returned HTTP 403. Discusses inference, subnetworks, KV caching and a separate speculative draft model; GPT-5.6 Sol changes that draft model in architecture experiments. The one-billion figure counts active users, not parameters. No nominal total or activated parameter count is given for Terra, and the draft architecture is not Terra production architecture.

sources.title: Prompt caching guide
sources.evidence: Describes reusable KV states and GPT-5.6-and-later caching behavior. It supplies no explicit full production Transformer, dense or MoE classification for Terra.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: The archived recipe explains Transformer KV caching but explicitly restricts its applicability to models before GPT-5.6; that architecture explanation is not transferred to Terra.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses accepts PDFs; vision-capable models receive extracted text and page images. Chat Completions supports PDF file inputs. This establishes an API file format when combined with exact Terra vision/endpoint support, not a separate native PDF modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service access while retaining service IP rights. Together with hosted Terra availability and model-weight security, this supports a proprietary service classification rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 Preview System Card, June 26, 2026
sources.evidence: Describes an earlier limited preview for a small group of trusted partners and plans for general availability in coming weeks. The July 9 date is the subsequent public product/API release, not this restricted preview.

sources.title: OpenAI EU AI Act resources
sources.evidence: The public training-summary list includes GPT-5.6 Luna but no exact Terra summary. Luna training-data quantities or specifications are not transferred to Terra.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: No exact gpt-5.6-terra shutdown entry was found in the current page; Terra appears as a recommended replacement for older models. This is documentation review, not an operational endpoint test.

sources.title: Estimating the Parameter Counts of the Claude 5 and GPT-5.6 Families
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27 as an independent estimate lead. The July 31 behavioral study lists Terra at 702B and Terra-Pro at 750B IKP-effective parameters. Section 2 explicitly defines the quantity as calibrated knowledge-capacity equivalence rather than true weight count; section 3 says architecture and true size cannot be resolved by this method. It supplies neither a nominal model specification nor an active count. Behavioral fingerprinting is not a developer-confirmed base-model relationship. These estimates are not adopted.

sources.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
sources.evidence: Freshly opened the original July technical report on October 27 to check later model-team comparisons. Table 1 explicitly reports total and activated parameters only for Kimi K2 and K3. Tables 2, 3 and 5 compare GPT-5.6 Sol on evaluation scores, not parameters; no Terra entry is present. Neither Kimi counts nor the differently identified Sol comparisons can establish Terra size.

family.note: The numerical designation identifies the generation; Terra is the tier. Correct the cross-generation gpt-terra grouping.

release_date.note: Retain explicit public product/API release. June 26 was a restricted trusted-partner preview; July 30 pricing and August 5 serving changes are not initial releases.

open_weights.note: Distributed as hosted product/API access; original card describes protecting proprietary model weights. No public weight distribution is identified.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification, not an SPDX identifier or a claim of downloadable weight-license terms.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 parameter-only re-audit reopened the exact API specification, launch, original system card, later GPT-6.1 Terra comparison tables and inference article. No published nominal total count or explicit relationship to a named base with a published count was found. Exact-name total/parameter searches and later original model-team comparisons produced no stronger disclosure. The 702B IKP figure measures effective knowledge capacity; pricing, relative model size, active users and draft-model experiments do not establish Terra parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 searches for exact Terra activated/active-parameter disclosures found no supported nominal count. Later OpenAI exact Terra columns contain evaluation scores; the Kimi K3 report has an activated-parameter table for Kimi models and compares Sol rather than Terra. IKP estimates do not measure per-token activation. No active value is inferred from total size, presumed density, safety activation classifiers or serving subnetworks.

architecture.note: Exact Terra internal activations, reasoning training and current KV caching are documented, but the reviewed sources do not explicitly establish a structural production classification. The older Transformer caching recipe excludes this generation; speculative draft architecture and serving subnetworks are not evidence of Terra MoE. Bounded exact-name architecture/interpretability/training searches located no stronger primary disclosure.

context_window.note: Current exact API documentation states 1,050,000 context, with explicit 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 output. Applies to the listed undated identifier; no immutable dated snapshot or product UI context limit is inferred.

modalities.note: Retain text/image input and text output, with PDF as supported API file input converted to text/page images. Hosted image-generation tooling is not native image output; audio/video endpoints are unsupported.

reasoning.note: Exact API supports none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max. Original card independently evaluates Terra chain-of-thought. No public ultra API effort is inferred from product configuration.

tool_call.note: Exact page lists function calling and Responses tools, including search, code interpreter, hosted shell, apply patch, skills, computer use, MCP and tool search.

Estimating the Parameter Counts of the Claude 5 and GPT-5.6 Families

patch.notes: Public product/API release was July 9, 2026, after a limited trusted-partner preview on June 26. The current API page lists only the undated gpt-5.6-terra identifier, with 1,050,000 context, 922,000 input and 128,000 output tokens. Reasoning defaults to medium and supports none through max. PDF is an API file-input format converted to text and page images. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; knowledge-capacity estimates and separate draft-model experiments are not Terra parameter specifications. Production architecture is unverified. No exact API shutdown notice was found; endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts after reopening exact OpenAI documentation, original and later system cards, launch and inference engineering, and searching later research comparisons. Reject the 702B IKP capacity equivalent as a weight count; no supported counted-base lineage or nominal active convention was found. Preserve the other 12 field assessments, including the family, license and description corrections, July 9 public release and documented API capabilities.
